approved_unit_rate_usd.description: Approved unit rate used to bridge the physical transaction to the reconciled financial amount.

baseline_settlement_date.description: Posting, payment, or close date under post_supported_maintenance_labor.

business_need_date.description: Documented business or control date that the decision must protect.

control_threshold_usd.description: Exact USD threshold for signed-maintenance-labor posting variance.

controlled_settlement_date.description: Posting, payment, or close date under estimate_missing_hours.

decision_timing_status.description: Use ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise use LATE.

document_amount_usd.description: signed labor value for the maintenance order

escalated_settlement_date.description: Posting, payment, or close date under defer_current_period_charge.

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 because the third option is outside current authority; otherwise use 0.

financial_control.description: Task-specific monetary control that governs the action; it is not assumed to be an invoice tolerance.

financial_document_or_record.description: Immutable invoice, PO, cost record, or close exception being reconciled.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the independently documented business/control date; positive means late.

physical_transaction_quantity.description: Positive provider-posted quantity magnitude. The Oracle transaction type supplies the issue, return, or reversal direction; do not negate a return.

physical_transaction_unit.description: Provider unit of measure for the physical transaction.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented incremental spend or avoidable exposure of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing post_supported_maintenance_labor, estimate_missing_hours, defer_current_period_charge.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying all source constraints.

supported_amount_usd.description: hours inside asset work and open period not already posted
